tasks.short: Select craft materials for their physical and aesthetic characteristics.

steps.what: Look up candidate materials and their stated strength, weight, and size
Examine material color, texture, balance, malleability, and other physical characteristics
Select materials that suit the intended craft object
Note selected material references and reasons for later craft work

tasks.design: Configure native material-reference folders and saved searches in {DOCS}. Keep physical examination and artistic selection human, with a short selection note using the existing document template.
tasks.previous_blocker: Material references can require repeated browsing before hands-on comparison.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved searches can narrow that browsing without substituting for tactile assessment.
tasks.still_hard: Texture, balance, and malleability are experienced in relation to the intended object.
tasks.human_edge: The artist judges material character and expressive fit through handling.
tasks.altitude: Make reference lookup slightly quicker while preserving material judgement.

reach.task: Compare material behaviour in sample work
reach.learn: Which qualities only emerge during handling

evidence.claim: Native saved document searches could reduce material-reference browsing while leaving physical selection unchanged.

assumptions: Lookup, physical examination, selection, and the short written selection note are included separately.
Material suppliers produce existing descriptions and dimensions; the artist verifies source relevance in s1 and physical qualities in s2. No new supplier data-entry duty is introduced.
Native search touches lookup only. No machine consumes an assumed strength or suitability flag; missing descriptions require manual browsing.
The artist records material reference and reason in s4's five retained hours. A template touches its structure but no saving is claimed for its substantive content or near-zero save.
This is selection, not the detailed specification setting owned once by task 9253; no external send or self-approval is proposed.
unknowns: How much material browsing is repeated
research_questions: Does a saved native search reduce material-reference browsing without extra cataloguing effort?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 reference-browsing scenario: B=100, R=12+45+35+5=97; gross 3%, less 1 upkeep gives central net 2%; conservative 0-1%.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop creative concepts for handmade craft objects.

steps.what: Review inspirations and define creative aims for craft objects
Sketch alternative craft concepts and explore visual variations

loop.purpose: Explore a bounded set of visual concept variations
loop.input: Artist's concept brief and permitted references
loop.output: Up to four labelled exploratory images
loop.check: Artist checks expressive relevance, relation to references, and whether depicted geometry could be explored in the chosen craft
loop.stop: One set and one revision; unusable concepts return to hand sketching
loop.why_not_simpler: A template cannot create varied visual forms from an open artistic brief

steps.what: Explore candidate creative ideas through physical craft mockups
Choose the craft concept and identify the artistic direction
Record the chosen craft concept and reasons for its direction

tasks.design: Use {OTHER} image-generation and sketching software for a bounded visual exploration, with native sketch tools tried first. The artist retains physical mockups, concept selection, and the final concept record in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Exploring several visual alternatives can require repeated sketch preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Image tools can produce exploratory visual variants from an artist's brief.
tasks.still_hard: A convincing image may describe an impossible object or an uninteresting artistic direction.
tasks.human_edge: The artist supplies intent, material understanding, and the final aesthetic judgement.
tasks.altitude: Explore some visual alternatives faster while retaining hands-on concept development.

reach.task: Review physical feasibility of a visual concept
reach.learn: Which image features cannot translate into fabrication

evidence.claim: Adobe Creative Studio generates and edits images with content credentials, supporting exploratory image creation rather than craft feasibility.

assumptions: Reference review, sketch exploration, physical studies, selection, and written concept recording are separately included.
The artist produces form intention, permitted reference identifiers, craft medium, scale intention, and exploration limits in s1; its 15% share includes brief preparation.
Native sketch duplication is tested before generation. Generated geometry is never treated as a structured fabrication input or feasibility flag.
S2's 21 retained hours include selection, correction, and discarded variants. Unsuitable results return to hand sketches; no unlimited regeneration is assumed.
The concept note template touches s5 but no saving is claimed for its substantive writing or save. No generated image is automatically published or sent.
unknowns: Whether visual generation fits the artist's practice
How often generated ideas survive physical trials
research_questions: Does one bounded set of variants reduce total exploration time after physical feasibility checks?

incremental.description: Maintain reference permissions and review failed exploration patterns

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 visual-exploration scenario: B=100, R=15+21+35+15+5=91; gross 9%, less 4 upkeep gives central net 5%; conservative 0-2%.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Set and document craft material, dimension, and finish specifications.

steps.what: Review the craft concept and material characteristics for specification setting
Choose materials, dimensions, and finishes that fit the craft concept
Measure dimensions and test finish samples for the selected specification
Write material, dimension, and finish specifications for the craft object
Check the specification sheet against measured samples and intended finishes

tasks.design: Configure a native specification-sheet template in {DOCS} with reusable material labels, units, and finish sections. The artist still makes the choices, measures samples, enters the values, and checks the written specification.
tasks.previous_blocker: Specification writing may repeatedly rebuild field labels, unit notation, and section layout.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document forms can reuse structure while leaving the actual values editable and explicit.
tasks.still_hard: Material behaviour and the intended finish determine the specification, not the template.
tasks.human_edge: The artist judges the relationship between measured dimensions and the desired object.
tasks.altitude: Spend less time formatting specifications and keep the specification decisions.

reach.learn: Which tolerances and finish descriptions prevent fabrication ambiguity

evidence.claim: Native specification templates could reduce repeated structure and unit formatting without deciding materials or dimensions.

assumptions: The written specification is explicitly part of setting specifications and is not excluded as administration.

The artist produces material reference, dimension value, unit, tolerance where needed, finish description, and sample reference in s4, using observations from s2 and s3; twelve retained hours include all substantive capture.
Native templates are tested before custom software. No machine action consumes an assumed structured specification or performs an unlisted calculation.
Missing measurements or unclear finishes require direct measurement or manual description; a template cannot fill them.
S4 saves repeated layout and labels only; its near-zero internal save has no saving credit or self-gate. No external handoff is proposed.
unknowns: How much specification formatting already uses templates
Whether objects share a useful common specification structure
research_questions: Does the native sheet reduce total specification-writing time while preserving necessary tolerances and finish detail?

incremental.description: Maintain specification template fields and examples

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 repeated-sheet scenario: B=100, R=15+35+20+12+10=92; gross 8%, less 3 upkeep gives central net 5%; conservative 0-2%.

tasks.short: Advertise craft work through online materials and brochures.

steps.what: Photograph craft products and select representative work images
Record verified product facts and advertising offer details
Write advertising copy describing the craft products and work

loop.purpose: Draft concise product descriptions from verified facts
loop.input: Product facts, actual photographs, offer terms, and artist tone guidance
loop.output: Draft descriptions without invented provenance or availability
loop.check: Artist checks materials, dimensions, technique claims, tone, price, and availability against the actual product record
loop.stop: One revision; unsupported claims are removed or written manually
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed text template cannot describe varied handmade work naturally

steps.what: Lay out internet advertising and brochure variants from the selected content
Check final advertising proofs for product accuracy, layout, and offer terms
Publish the checked internet advertising to the selected channels
Send the checked brochure artwork for the agreed print run

tasks.design: Use native layout templates in {OTHER} design software to create online and brochure variants from checked product facts and real photographs. Bounded copy drafting assists writing; the artist checks the final proofs and performs separate online publication and print-artwork sends.
tasks.previous_blocker: Advertising requires repeated copywriting and layout resizing around the same product facts.
tasks.enabler_now: Template-driven design tools can fill channel variants, and a bounded assistant can draft checked descriptions.
tasks.still_hard: Advertising must represent the real handmade object and the artist's intent accurately.
tasks.human_edge: The artist chooses truthful images and descriptions that convey the work's character.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repeated layout and copy preparation while retaining editorial and publication decisions.

reach.learn: Which crops or layouts misrepresent scale and texture

evidence.claim: Figma Buzz supports locked template areas and spreadsheet-filled variants, supporting template-driven advertising layouts.
Checked product-copy drafting could reduce authoring without inventing materials, provenance, or stock availability.

assumptions: Photography, fact capture, copywriting, layout, proof checking, online publication, and the print send are separate counted actions.

The artist produces product identifier, material, dimensions, technique, price, available quantity, image identifier, offer terms, and channel intent in s2; its 10% share includes capture and fact verification.

The artist configures template dimensions and permitted image/text areas during setup, with ongoing changes in upkeep. S4 cannot infer missing product fields; absent or overflowing content returns to manual layout.
Native template configuration is tried before custom code. OTHER means camera equipment in s1 and design-layout software in s4, not a hidden integration.

S5 checks exact final proofs and the manager-selected channel, budget, printer, and run settings. S6 and s7 retain their full real publication/send effort; no saving is credited to a button click or internal save.
unknowns: Whether channel variants already use templates
Which print specifications and advertising channels recur
research_questions: Do template variants and checked copy drafting reduce total proof preparation without more corrections?

already_counted.description: Copy review and final proof checking

incremental.description: Maintain channel templates and inspect copy/layout failure patterns

approvals.approved_version: Exact checked proof snapshot, product facts, offer terms, online channel, audience, schedule, and spending settings checked in s5; changes require renewed checking
Exact checked brochure proof snapshot, printer recipient, print format, quantity, and run settings checked in s5; changes require renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 repeated-variant scenario: B=100, R=20+10+9+0+15+10+10=74; gross 26%, less 6 upkeep gives central net 20%; conservative 0-10%.

role.altitude: Keep tactile and artistic judgement while reducing reference browsing, visual exploration overhead, specification formatting, and advertising production.
reach: Compare material studies with fine artists
Review fabrication and presentation constraints with industrial designers
role.ambitious_version: A craft artist whose records and advertising are easier to prepare without replacing the handmade work or artistic choice.
